debug.title: Debug
debug.hook-note: These act on the real hook: ejects and Hello overrides travel the dev control channel, and reinjection runs through the app's real injection loop. The version and state above are what the hook reported at the last handshake, not something this page set.
debug.encounter-note: These queue real events onto the hook's event stream, so firing them mid-fight mixes them into the live encounter. End and Reset both stop an in-progress fight and save whatever damage it recorded to your log history as a genuine entry; End also stamps that log with the scenario's fake quest id and timer. Inside a Conflux run they act on the run instead: Reset finalises it, End only marks it cleared.
debug.stale-hook-note: Needs a dev hook that is injected and current: a stale hook-dbg.dll cannot decode these requests. Rebuild the hook and use the tray's "Reload hook (dev)" first if these fail to connect.
debug.hold-out-active: Hook held out — reinjection is paused, so the badge reads "No game found" even while the game is running. Use "Allow reinject" (or Refresh) to release it.
debug.sent-frames_one: Queued {{count}} event on the hook's broadcast channel
debug.sent-frames_other: Queued {{count}} events on the hook's broadcast channel
debug.sent-nothing: The hook accepted the batch but nothing was listening — this should not happen.

toolbox.title: Toolbox
toolbox.game-not-running: Game is not running. Start Granblue Fantasy: Relink first — the helper reads your sigil box and the synthesis seed from the game.
toolbox.hook-outdated: The game is running an outdated version of the hook. Restart the game to load the update.
toolbox.hook-unreachable: Couldn't reach the game hook. If this keeps happening, restart the game and Relink Logs.
toolbox.invalid-trait: Pick a real trait (the empty-slot placeholder can't be searched).
toolbox.rng-unpredictable: The synthesis RNG has no seed yet. Perform one synthesis or complete a quest, then search again.
toolbox.results-caveat: Predictions are for your next synthesis only. Completing a quest or synthesizing anything changes the seed — search again after either.
toolbox.no-results: No pair in your sigil box produces this result with the current seed. Try again after the next quest.
toolbox.om-game-not-running: Game is not running. Start Granblue Fantasy: Relink first — the predictor reads the overmastery RNG state from the game.
toolbox.om-unpredictable: This character's overmastery RNG has no seed yet. Roll overmasteries once (any level) for them first, then predict again.
toolbox.om-character-not-found: This character isn't in the game's roster yet.
toolbox.om-rng-override-active: The game is mid-roll right now — try again in a second.
toolbox.om-invalid-tier: That overmastery level isn't one the game offers.
toolbox.om-slot-out-of-range: This character sits outside the game's overmastery RNG table — their rolls can't be predicted.
toolbox.stale-results: The game's RNG has changed since these results were computed — they may no longer be accurate. Run it again for a fresh list.
toolbox.om-no-match: No matching roll in the next {{rolls}} — try more rolls or a lower minimum level.
toolbox.om-results-caveat: Each line is one future overmastery roll for this character and level, in order. Rolling with a different character or level doesn't consume these; completing a quest may reshuffle them — predict again after.
toolbox.tm-game-not-running: Game is not running. Start the game and open this tool again.
toolbox.tm-unpredictable: The RNG state is uninitialized — do one transmarvel roll first, then predictions will work.
toolbox.tm-no-hits: No wishlist hits in the next {{rolls}} rolls.
toolbox.tm-no-sigils: Add sigils you want to roll for.
toolbox.tm-no-stones: Add wrightstones you want to roll for.
toolbox.tm-results-caveat: Predictions assume your next RNG-consuming action is a transmarvel roll.
